diagram.diagram_name: Currynomics Extended T-DM / Extended Requirement Diagram first draft

organizationGoal.mission_statement: Govern DAO participation, treasury, protocol, and token policy while preserving retained Redcurry issuance and licensed-distribution boundaries and limiting concentration risk.

treasury.DAO_fiscal_policy_goal: Fund approved ecosystem activity while preventing unchecked concentration of treasury control.

decisionMakingMethod.DM_goal: Govern Redcurry issuance and reserve composition while preserving separation of duties.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_scope: AR1 Redcurry issuance and reserve assets.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_method: Retained professional authorization with constrained execution and oversight; exact workflow to be confirmed.
decisionMakingMethod.voting_requirement: Not an ordinary community vote; professional investment-board decision criteria pending confirmation.
decisionMakingMethod.proposal_requirement: Holding or investment actor submits a documented issuance or reserve action.

decisionMakingMethod.DM_goal: Govern licensed-partner eligibility and distribution while monitoring partner concentration.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_scope: AR2 partner eligibility and licensed Redcurry distribution.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_method: Compliance review and authorized legal approval; exact authority to be confirmed.
decisionMakingMethod.proposal_requirement: Compliance or operations submits partner evidence and exposure assessment.

decisionMakingMethod.DM_goal: Separate proposal, filtering, voting, execution, veto, emergency, and audit authority.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_scope: AR3 DAO treasury and parameters; AR4 governance process and community goals; AR5 protocol upgrades and DAO-token policy.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_method: Hybrid forum, temperature check, formal token vote, and gated execution; parameters pending approval.
decisionMakingMethod.voting_requirement: Eligible DAO-token holder; identity, delegation, quorum, and weighting rules pending.
decisionMakingMethod.proposal_requirement: Community proposal followed by moderation and designated formal submission; exact thresholds pending.

decisionMakingMethod.DM_goal: Enable participation without allowing allocation, rewards, vesting, or locking to compound control unchecked.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_scope: Time-sensitive DAO-token voting for AR3, subject to lifecycle and concentration review.
decisionMakingMethod.DM_method: Candidate conviction or time-weighted voting; not yet approved.
decisionMakingMethod.voting_requirement: Approved DAO-token eligibility, lock-duration, voting-weight, decay, and delegation rules.
decisionMakingMethod.proposal_requirement: Proposal has passed ER3 filtering and formalization gates.

tokenManager.tokenomic_policy_goal: Maintain demand-driven collateral-constrained issuance and licensed distribution.
Support participation while constraining concentration created by allocation, rewards, vesting, locking, and voting weight.

token.token_utility: asset-linked value; stability; payment; prospective collateral utility
governance access; participation; reputational value; candidate reward

mechanism.value: Asset-linked value, payment, stability, and prospective collateral utility
mechanism.trigger: eligible user accesses an approved Redcurry use
mechanism.postcondition: use and applicable eligibility evidence recorded

mechanism.precondition: partner exposure and legal eligibility reviewed

mechanism.value: Capped supply, allocations, vesting, and unlock schedule
mechanism.postcondition: circulating supply and concentration review updated

mechanism.value: Candidate DAO-token reward for participation or Redcurry staking
mechanism.trigger: approved eligible participation or staking event
mechanism.postcondition: reward allocation and resulting voting-power exposure recorded

mechanism.value: Candidate governance locking, weighting, and decay rule
mechanism.precondition: lock-duration, exit, decay, and concentration gates approved
mechanism.postcondition: voting weight and unlock condition recorded

mechanism.value: Community proposal and designated formal submission
mechanism.trigger: proposal satisfies scope and submission criteria
mechanism.postcondition: formal proposal identity and provenance recorded

mechanism.value: Moderation, feasibility review, and temperature check

mechanism.precondition: eligibility, snapshot, quorum, and weighting parameters fixed

mechanism.value: Compute authorization result and decisive coalition
mechanism.postcondition: result, coalition, and concentration review recorded

mechanism.value: Separate multisignature execution of authorized proposal
mechanism.trigger: proposal authorized and execution gate passed
mechanism.precondition: authorization, signer independence, veto, and emergency checks pass

mechanism.value: Appeal, audit, veto, and time-bounded emergency review
mechanism.trigger: appeal, anomaly, or emergency condition recorded
mechanism.postcondition: reasoned outcome, expiry, and follow-up action published

mechanism.precondition: weighting and decay scenario passed concentration review
mechanism.postcondition: effective voting power and decisive-coalition evidence recorded

goal.value: Preserve asset-linked value through constrained Redcurry issuance
Provide compliant access through licensed distribution partners
Enable accountable and inclusive community influence within retained boundaries
Sustain participation without compounding control unchecked

qualitygoal.value: Concentration effects reviewable under external TEDM criteria M1, M5, and M6
Ownership and effective-voting-power concentration remains reviewable under external record M1
Agenda-control concentration remains reviewable under external record M2
Privileged-control coalition independence remains reviewable under external record M3
Licensed-partner exposure remains reviewable under external record M4
Unlock and reward concentration shocks remain reviewable under external record M5
Decisive-coalition diversity and authorization-execution conformity remain reviewable under external record M6
